cookieConsent.title: Cookie Preferences
cookieConsent.message: Your privacy matters! This portfolio runs entirely in your browser - no servers, no backend. Any text, images, or files you upload never leave your machine and are processed locally using high-performance algorithms with Web Workers and WebAssembly. I only use Google Analytics to understand how visitors interact with the site. This website is hosted with ❤️ on GitHub and will always remain ad-free (promise!). Do you accept cookies?

text.97b4d207576c: Senior Experience Engineer with 10+ years of experience building enterprise platforms, browser-based creative tools, investment applications, graphics engines, internal commerce systems, and product customization software. I specialize in Angular, TypeScript, React, SVG, Canvas, WebGL, browser graphics, performance engineering, accessibility, and complex frontend architecture. My work spans the complete product lifecycle, from requirement discovery and technical investigation to architecture, implementation, optimization, documentation, mentoring, and production delivery. I have independently sustained frontend ownership for business-critical enterprise applications, built a 3D product-preview system that generated more than $40,000 in customization revenue, improved raster-to-vector conversion performance by 50%, and created product-focused engineering tools from first principles. I combine frontend engineering depth with UX thinking, domain analysis, AI-assisted development, and a hands-on ability to reverse-engineer complex software and hardware systems.

Technical contributions and core competencies are reflected through generalized engineering practices, including enterprise Angular and React architectures, performance engineering, complex data visualization, and resilient frontend systems.
